name: agentpad13-behavior-sim
description: Behavioral simulation of the shipped agentpad13 UF2 on rp2040js: full 13-switch sweep, encoder, TTP223 touch polarity, joystick ADC->HID gamepad, and per-index LED addressability read back from the ws2812 DMA buffer. Reuses ../tests/emulator/node_modules; no dependencies of its own. The default --touch=board model (board truth) PASSES 33/33 on the current firmware and is the gate; the --touch=firmware arm models the pre-fix assumption and FAILS 4 by design, which is what proves the harness still discriminates. (CORRECTED 2026-08-15: this line used to say '--touch=board FAILS on the current firmware by design', which was true only until the 2026-08-13 TTP223 touch fix - see README 'The defect this harness catches', kept as a historical record.)

scripts.sim:all: npm run sim:default:fwpolarity && npm run sim:vial:fwpolarity
